[\mathbf{T}]_{\mathcal{B}} = P_{\small \mathcal{C} \to \mathcal{B}} \cdot [\mathbf{T}]_{\mathcal{C}} \cdot P_{\small \mathcal{C} \to \mathcal{B}}^{-1}.
$$
